upstream_comparison.method: Official raw.githubusercontent.com HTTPS downloads from exact tags; raw bytes hashed locally. Sources read as text only and never compiled or executed. Main three also compared with git diff --no-index: zero differences, exit code 0.
findings: No differences in any of the nine bounded source files or their direct crypto/encoding/provider-selection references.

IdentityV3 generation remains PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, PRF enum value 2, 16-byte random salt, 32-byte subkey, marker 0x01, three big-endian UInt32 header fields, 61 binary bytes and 84 base64 characters. Iteration count remains explicit in Tunner and embedded in stored verifiers.

Native verification still follows embedded iteration/PRF/size values. Tunner's existing pre-KDF exact header/cost admission remains required and unchanged. A surrounding stopwatch still does not interrupt a synchronous PBKDF2 call.

NETCOREAPP PBKDF2 selection still uses NetCorePbkdf2Provider and Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2. This bounded ASP.NET source review does not assert equality of dotnet/runtime binaries or OS cryptographic providers.

AuthenticatorTokenProvider still obtains the seed through the manager, Base32-decodes it, computes Unix seconds divided by 30 and checks offsets -2 through +2 using Rfc6238AuthenticationService.ComputeTotp with null modifier. NET6+ ComputeTotp still uses HMACSHA1.TryHashData and modulo 1000000, with the same dynamic truncation.

The separate Rfc6238AuthenticationService three-minute GenerateCode/ValidateCode helpers are not the AuthenticatorTokenProvider thirty-second acceptance path. Its stale 90-second comment does not override the actual five-counter loop.

Native TOTP returns bool without a matched-counter result or replay consumption; Tunner's existing full-horizon retention, transactional replay claims, owner locks, capacity, clock and budget guards remain unchanged.

patch_security_findings: Both production profile contracts admit only exact strings 10.0.13 and 10.0.15. All algorithm, digits, period, native window, retention, work, concurrency, format, origin and owner-policy validation is preserved.

RecoveryCodeNative and TotpNativeVerifier are absent from the patch. Their installed AssemblyInformationalVersion StartsWith(selectedVersion + plus, Ordinal) checks remain intact; admitting the pair does not allow a profile pinned to the other installed patch.

Shared test-only helper requires a nonempty build-metadata suffix and exact allowlisted version before supplying a synthetic fixture value. Tests reject missing metadata, empty values, 14 and 16, and verify PasswordHasher and AuthenticatorTokenProvider share the same assembly.

Recovery negative creates the other admitted profile, proves Supports returns false, and requires native construction to throw InvalidOperationException. This reaches the installed native guard rather than merely failing unsupported profile validation.

TOTP negative validates the other admitted profile, submits a canonical native code through the existing real-transaction/Account-row/advisory-lock helper, expects DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, and compares complete persisted factor plus ordered replay-claim snapshots before/after committed SaveChanges. Restoring the original version then accepts the exact same code, proving rejection did not consume it. No raw seed/code is serialized into snapshots.

Existing finite browser oracle and recovery browser fixture remain pinned to 13; this patch does not qualify 15 browser execution or change their fail-closed behavior. Do not treat later browser failures on 15 as covered by this native qualification.
